description: A ball and stick model of methane (CH₄). Use appropriate colors for each atom type (conventionally: black or dark gray for carbon, white for hydrogen). Stick distances should be roughly proportionate to real molecular bond lengths. One central carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms in a tetrahedral arrangement.
